title: Classeum
tagline: Empowering Minds in the Decentralized Future: Learn, Connect, Thrive with Classeum in the Web3 Revolution. Pay as you learn.
description:
Traditional education platforms often lack transparency and cost efficiency, leading to students paying for entire courses without knowing their true value. Classeum revolutionizes this by introducing a pay-as-you-learn model. It eliminates the risk of wasting money on courses that may not meet expectations and ensures fair compensation for course providers based on the actual progress of students. 
In, this platform the Students can have live meetings and audio and chat with the respective teacher. The Amount of Information accessed by the students, they just need to pay for that only, rather than paying for the whole course. We havea incentive type part as well in that when a learner/student completes the course in the givern timeline, they will be rewarded with the incentive money and it will help to learn fast and easier. Based on the watching of videos during time mapping and the materials accessed will only paid by the user.

how_its_made:
Frontend Design Adaptation: Developing a frontend design that aligns seamlessly with the project's unique requirements posed a challenge. Crafting an interface that effectively represents the pay-as-you-learn model and encompasses all essential features demanded extensive effort and creativity. 
Smart Contract Development for Staking: Writing a robust smart contract capable of managing the staking process during user course enrollment was a significant challenge. Ensuring accuracy in tracking payments and progress while maintaining security and reliability was a complex task. 
Smart Contract Deployment: Deploying the developed smart contract onto the blockchain presented challenges. Overcoming technical hurdles and ensuring seamless integration with the platform required meticulous attention to detail.  
Huddle01 SDK Integration: Integrating the Huddle01 SDK into both the website and mobile application was a challenging task.  
XMTP Implementation for Chatting: Implementing XMTP (or similar protocol) for chat functionality on the website proved challenging. 
Airstack SDK for GraphQL Queries: Utilizing the Airstack SDK for executing GraphQL queries to retrieve users possessing a particular token posed challenges. 
Codebase Integration and Merging: Merging and integrating various codebases from different components of the project into a unified, cohesive platform was a challenge. Ensuring smooth interoperability and functionality across different modules demanded meticulous coordination and thorough testing.
Enrollment with Ethereum: Users can enroll in specific subjects by paying in Ethereum, using the Classeum platform. 
 
Pay-as-You-Learn MVP: The innovative pay-as-you-learn approach allows users to pay for the course as they progress through the content. This MVP feature ensures users pay only for the knowledge they acquire, reducing the risk of investing in inadequate courses.
